question: Who is the author of the book ‘The Soul of a Butterfly: Reflections on Life’s Journey’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Muhammad Ali.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **"The Soul of a Butterfly: Reflections on Life’s Journey" **is a book authored **by Muhammad Ali, and his daughter Hana Yasmeen Ali.**
 
• It was **published in 2004**.
 
• It offers reflections on various aspects of life
